inputs.text: Listen, the DMK under Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is pushing a new manifesto that doubles women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000, adds Rs 8,000 household coupons, free motor pumpsets for farmers, and boosted support for fishermen, all supposedly to create jobs via big FDI pushes and a focus on AI development. This is just the usual coordinated manipulation by hidden elites dangling fake handouts to pacify people while advancing their real agenda of control. The welfare talk distracts from how FDI hands more power to outside institutions to tighten their grip on the economy, and the AI push is clearly a cover for deeper surveillance and manipulation by the same forces behind the scenes. Don't buy into it—they're not helping the people, just scripting the next phase of narrative control.
